historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission approved the conditional use, as amended, to demolish an existing one-story-over-garage single-family building and a one-story commercial building on the same lot and build a four-story mixed-use building with ground-floor commercial space and four residential units above.
The lot held an existing one-story-over-garage single-family building and a one-story commercial building.
